note: GOVERNED LOW-COST PAID lane catalog for cheaper Chinese / China-adjacent LLM endpoints. This is a DISTINCT lane from architecture/free_limited_llm_endpoint_registry.json (the FREE lane) — every entry here is LOW-COST PAID (cost_class lowcost_usd), billed per token, NOT free. Pricing is web-verified ~USD/Mtok as of 2026-06 and is approximate (list price, pre-promo, excl. cache/batch discounts) — reconfirm against official provider docs before any spend. Every entry is candidate/probation/watchlist (NEVER active); no raw keys (secret_ref only); model output is NEVER treated as truth. Companion doc: _repos/shared-backend-components/context/research/chinese-lowcost-llm-endpoints.md. Checked by scripts/check_lowcost_llm_endpoint_registry.py.
governance_law: LOWCOST != FREE: every entry is low-cost PAID (cost_class lowcost_usd), billed per token — do NOT treat as a free tier and do NOT merge into the free registry. CANDIDATE != ACTIVE: production_allowed is false for every entry; status is candidate/probation/watchlist (never active); promotion requires official paid/ZDR terms + security/privacy review + receipts + fallback. DATA-CLASS + JURISDICTION POLICY IS LOAD-BEARING: low-cost and China-region lanes may carry ONLY public + internal_non_sensitive data; they must NEVER carry customer data, regulated data, secrets, confidential data, or PII — those route ONLY to paid-enterprise-ZDR providers or self-hosted/private inference. Region/jurisdiction + data-residency metadata is required on every entry; a China-mainland jurisdiction caps allowed_data_classes to public/internal_non_sensitive regardless of price. SECRETS ARE REFS ONLY: secret_ref is a vault://-style reference, never a raw API key. OUTPUT != TRUTH: any output from these endpoints is a candidate artifact, never governed-context truth, and is gated through the Teleon Inference Gateway with a ModelInvocationReceipt. UNPAID-USAGE-TRAINS-VENDOR CAUTION: where a provider's free/unpaid tier may be used to train the vendor (Gemini-style), that caution is carried in data_use_note — but this catalog is PAID usage, which generally carries stronger retention terms; verify per provider.

lane_taxonomy.free/*: The no-cost / rate-limited tier (GitHub Models, Groq, Gemini free, etc.). Lives in architecture/free_limited_llm_endpoint_registry.json — NOT this file. Prototype-only; free-tier data may train the vendor; never customer-sensitive.
lane_taxonomy.lowcost/global-cheap: Low-cost PAID providers with a clean international/non-China data-residency option (e.g. Qwen Model Studio International @ Singapore, SiliconFlow .com). Cheapest safe-region routes for public/internal_non_sensitive bulk work.
lane_taxonomy.lowcost/china-cheap: Low-cost PAID providers whose primary jurisdiction/data-residency is China-mainland (DeepSeek direct, Baidu Qianfan, Tencent Hunyuan, Volcengine Ark/Doubao, StepFun, MiniMax CN). Often the cheapest per token, but China jurisdiction → ONLY public + internal_non_sensitive, NEVER customer/regulated/secrets/confidential.
lane_taxonomy.lowcost/code-agent: Low-cost PAID models tuned for coding / tool-use / agentic loops (DeepSeek V4, Z.AI GLM coding, StepFun agent, Kimi/Moonshot). Same data-class caps as their jurisdiction.
lane_taxonomy.lowcost/long-context: Low-cost PAID models with very large context windows (DeepSeek 1M ctx, MiniMax ~204K, Kimi 262K, StepFun 256K). For large-document/codebase passes; same data-class caps as jurisdiction.
lane_taxonomy.paid/safe: Paid ENTERPRISE providers with strong privacy/ZDR + acceptable jurisdiction — the ONLY lane allowed to carry customer / regulated / confidential / PII data. Not enumerated here (separate enterprise registry).
lane_taxonomy.selfhost/private: Self-hosted / private inference (local Ollama/vLLM, VPC) — the most-private lane; the fallback for any data that cannot leave the boundary. Not enumerated here (see the free registry's self_hosted_gateway rows + Teleon Sandbox).
lane_taxonomy.lowcost/edge-byo: customer's own edge account (BYO key); they run + pay, we dispatch
